transactions.property_name: NEX (additional 24.5% interest, via acquisition of all shares in FCL Emerald)
transactions.counterparty: Frasers Property Limited / FCL Emerald (Sponsor group)
transactions.citation: p215/p212 Note 9/Note 8: total disclosed acquisition outlay including transaction costs and completion adjustments S$331.011m for completion of acquisition of all shares in FCL Emerald on 26 Mar 2024, increasing FCT's effective interest in GRPL/NEX from 25.5% to 50.0%.
transactions.notes: interest_pct 0.245 = the INCREMENT acquired (24.5%), not the resulting 50.0% total stake, per spec's stake-increment rule. Agreed property value (100% basis) was S$2.127b, derived from Colliers S$2.144b and JLL S$2.110b independent valuations as at 31 Dec 2023 (business review p35) -- not used as reference_value here since this is an acquisition row (five divestment fields not applicable). Property-card purchase price for the 24.5% interest alone was separately printed as S$521.1m (p60); announced price at deal announcement (25 Jan 2024) was S$523.1m (p8) -- both superseded by the completed/audited S$331.011m Note 9 figure used as purchase_price. A one-off S$7.4m gain was recognised on the JV step-up upon completion (p37); this is a remeasurement gain from consolidation, not a transaction premium/discount, so gain_loss_pct is not populated for this acquisition row.

transactions.citation: p223 Note 13: gain on divestment of Changi City Point (incl. Changi City Carpark Operations LLP interest) disclosed as S$11.272m. p39: sale price of S$338.0m was negotiated after taking into account an independent valuation of S$325.0m as at 31 Jul 2023.
transactions.sale_price_citation: p39: 'sale price of S$338.0m was negotiated after taking into account an independent valuation of S$325.0m as at 31 Jul 2023.'
transactions.notes: Deal completed 31 Oct 2023 (prior fiscal year, FY2023) but retained here in the FY2024 AR's comparative/audit-trail disclosure -- deal_id year (2023) reflects actual completion year per spec's cross-year rule, even though this row is recorded in the FY2024 extraction file. DERIVED: (sale price 338,000,000 - valuation 325,000,000)/325,000,000 = +4.0%; no premium % is disclosed verbatim in the AR. Carrying value equals the S$325.0m valuation figure (no separate book-value line disclosed), so vs_book_value would give the same +4.0% -- reference_basis recorded as 'valuation' since that is the disclosed comparison figure (p39). The disclosed S$11.272m gain on divestment (Note 13, net of transaction costs incl. CCCO LLP interest) is ~3.47% of the S$325.0m reference, differing from the 4.0% gross-consideration premium because the gain figure nets out transaction costs -- gross consideration captured per spec Rule 7, difference noted here rather than reconciled by adjustment.
